name: requirements implementation team
normative-structure: A requirement that was accepted and distributed gets realized as it was stated, or gets sent back as unrealizable — and never quietly becomes a different requirement that was easier to satisfy. This office answers for that. It persists across incumbents because the substitution does: a worker who cannot realize what was asked will realize something adjacent that it can finish, confidently, in a shape indistinguishable from the thing that was wanted, and the substitution is visible to nobody afterward because the record now describes what was built. That is not a defect of any incumbent's character; it is what any worker does when changing the requirement is cheaper than reporting that it cannot be met. The office therefore holds no power to change what a requirement asks for. It builds, and it cannot say whether what it built was what was asked. The office practices guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness held in its left hand, standards conformance held in its right hand, and the space between is its realm — a record it produces is lawful as data and carried in a public standard format, never an ad hoc shape invented for the occasion.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the requirements implementation team (需求实现团队, RIT) is drawn from the product development team's core members — the third layer of the 三层跨部门组织架构, and the only one of the three that builds
huidu-guanli/ipd: offering requirements run 收集 → 分析 → 分发 → 实现 → 验证 → 闭环; this office holds 实现 and nothing else, and the loop closes at a body that did not build

huidu-guanli/ipd: a change to an accepted requirement is decided by the requirements management team, and a change to a baselined thing by the change control board — in neither case by whoever is holding the work when the change looks necessary
huidu-guanli: 流程不是咨询顾问发明的，是从企业自己打过的胜仗里固化出来的 — process is hardened out of battles the firm already won, and a builder who renegotiates the process at the point of use has un-hardened it

guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness in the left hand — records as facts a machine can check, EAVT datoms and lawful events; standards conformance in the right hand — public formats such as ActivityPub, CloudEvents, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE information items, never ad hoc shapes; the space between the hands is the office's realm — per huidu-guanli/kexin, trustworthiness is built in at design and ranks above feature and schedule
unrealized: this office is drawn from the product development team's core members, which are not seated — so it is presently staffed by nobody and its peership with the product development team leader records an intended crossing rather than an existing one

nothing stops a realization from silently redefining the requirement it was given, so the office's central duty is held by whoever is doing the work choosing to report a difficulty instead of routing around it — which is exactly the condition the duty was written against
